items.title: 阿曼Al Rusayl工业城披露七项总值逾2300万里亚尔投资合同
items.title_en: Oman's Al Rusayl Industrial City reports seven investment contracts exceeding RO23 million
items.summary: Al Rusayl工业城11月7日披露2026年上半年签署的七项投资合同，合计超过2300万阿曼里亚尔，面积121619平方米。包括1500万里亚尔医疗器械制造、150万里亚尔工程机械履带底盘制造及其他物业和服务项目。不是11月新签合同。
items.summary_en: On 7 November, Al Rusayl Industrial City reported seven investment contracts signed during the first half of 2026 worth more than RO23 million and covering 121,619 square metres. They include a RO15 million medical supplies manufacturing project, a RO1.5 million bulldozer and tracked-undercarriage facility and other property and service investments. These were not newly signed in November.
items.why_it_matters: 制造项目已取得投资合同，但施工时间和独立采购尚须核实。
items.why_it_matters_en: The manufacturing investments have signed contracts, while construction schedules and individual procurement packages remain to be verified.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注工业厂房、医疗设备制造和工程机械生产配套。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor industrial buildings, medical-equipment manufacturing and heavy-machinery production supply opportunities.
items.stage: 已签投资合同／近期披露

items.title: 阿曼与Petronas及OQEP签署83、84号海上油气区块联合研究协议
items.title_en: Oman signs offshore Blocks 83 and 84 study pact with Petronas and OQEP
items.summary: 阿曼能源和矿产部与马来西亚Petronas及OQ Exploration & Production于11月7日签署联合研究协议，开展Qurayyat海岸外83、84号区块地质及地球物理研究，面积分别约10875和14147平方公里。尚非勘探开采特许权或建设EPC合同。
items.summary_en: On 7 November, Oman's Ministry of Energy and Minerals signed a joint study agreement with Malaysia's Petronas and OQ Exploration & Production for geological and geophysical assessment of offshore Blocks 83 and 84 off Qurayyat, spanning about 10,875 and 14,147 square kilometres respectively. It is not yet a production concession or development EPC award.
items.why_it_matters: 大型海上研究范围提供长期能源潜力，但实际开发取决于研究成果。
items.why_it_matters_en: The extensive offshore acreage presents longer-term upstream potential, contingent on study outcomes.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注未来海上勘探、地球物理服务及海工供应链。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track future offshore exploration, geophysical services and marine engineering supply chains.

items.title: 布隆迪布琼布拉港项目发布21处鱼类产卵区保护工程招标
items.title_en: Burundi Bujumbura port programme tenders protection works for 21 fish-spawning areas
items.summary: 非洲开发银行于11月3日发布布隆迪坦噶尼喀湖布琼布拉港口改造及连接道路项目的21处鱼类产卵区生态保护工程采购。属于湖岸生态施工标段，未核定具体投标截止时间。
items.summary_en: On 3 November, the African Development Bank published a procurement invitation for ecological protection works covering 21 fish-spawning areas under the rehabilitation of Bujumbura Port and its access routes on Lake Tanganyika. This is a shoreline environmental works package; the exact bid deadline was not independently confirmed.
items.why_it_matters: 已有具体工程采购范围，但资格、投标期限需以官方文件为准。
items.why_it_matters_en: The works package has a defined scope, but bidder eligibility and deadlines must be confirmed in the official documents.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注湖岸生态防护、环境土建及工程材料供应。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor lake-shore protection, environmental civil works and materials supply.

items.title: 冈比亚Fatoto与Kuntaur卫生中心实验室设备采购
items.title_en: The Gambia tenders laboratory equipment for Fatoto and Kuntaur health centres
items.summary: 非洲开发银行于11月6日发布RB-VYWoSP项目医疗实验室设备采购公告，采购对象为冈比亚Fatoto和Kuntaur两所卫生中心。具体设备清单、数量、截止时间应以招标附件为准。
items.summary_en: On 6 November, the African Development Bank published a procurement notice under the RB-VYWoSP programme for laboratory equipment for Fatoto and Kuntaur health centres in The Gambia. Detailed equipment lists, quantities and bid deadlines are governed by tender documents.
items.why_it_matters: 具有医疗设备供货切入机会，但须核对进口认证和投标资质。
items.why_it_matters_en: The opportunity concerns medical equipment supply, subject to import approvals and procurement eligibility.
items.gci_opportunity: 寻找实验室设备出口、供应商及当地交付合作机会。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Explore laboratory equipment exports, distribution and local installation partnerships.

items.title: 迪拜Future Week的The Pitch开放创新项目与投资对接
items.title_en: Dubai Future Week's The Pitch opens startup showcasing and investor matchmaking
items.summary: 迪拜未来基金会宣布11月18日至21日举办Dubai Future Week，The Pitch平台聚焦气候适应基础设施、食品及供应链韧性、城市系统、能源与水资源等领域。面向具备产品、原型或可行方案的迪拜初创企业、科研项目提供展示及投资对接机会，并非政府工程采购。
items.summary_en: Dubai Future Foundation announced that Dubai Future Week will run from 18 to 21 November, with The Pitch highlighting climate-adaptive infrastructure, food and supply-chain resilience, urban systems, and energy and water resources. Dubai-based startups with viable products, prototypes or research-backed solutions may present to partners and investors. This is not a public construction tender.
items.why_it_matters: 活动可为AI、数字化与供应链业务提供客户开发机会。
items.why_it_matters_en: The event offers business-development opportunities for AI, digitalisation and supply-chain solutions.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注技术企业合作、投资对接及数字化服务客户。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Explore technology partnerships, investor introductions and digital-services customers.

items.title: ADNOC与印度Gujarat Energy签署十年液化天然气供应合同
items.title_en: ADNOC signs ten-year LNG supply contract with India's Gujarat Energy
items.sector: 液化天然气贸易与物流
items.summary: ADNOC于11月6日与印度Gujarat Energy签署十年液化天然气销售和采购协议，计划自2028年起由XRG国际天然气组合供应最多400万吨LNG。该合同是跨境能源贸易，不是油气建设项目。
items.summary_en: On 6 November, ADNOC signed a ten-year liquefied natural gas sales and purchase agreement with India's Gujarat Energy for up to four million tonnes of LNG from XRG's international gas portfolio, starting in 2028. This is a cross-border commodity supply agreement, not a construction contract.
items.why_it_matters: 体现能源贸易和运输需求，但未确认面向外部的物流招标。
items.why_it_matters_en: The agreement indicates an energy trade flow, but no open third-party logistics tender has been announced.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注LNG运输、贸易服务及跨境能源供应链发展。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor LNG shipping, trade services and cross-border energy supply chains.
